posts.title: The Final Run of the ICN: Goodbye to the Zagreb – Split RegioSwingers
posts.description: Bittersweet news comes to us this weekend from the Zagreb - Split line, with the last run of the ICN (InterCity Nagibni) service after more than two decades. ICN was introduced as HŽ's premium product using Bombardier RegioSwinger tilting trains in 2004, with an attempt to provide higher class of service and shorter travel times on the route between two largest Croatian cities. posts.title: 99 Bottles of Beer: Headless Macintosh Testing
posts.description: In this article I'll share a niche procedure for testing vintage Mac boards when you don't have access to a chassis or a display. This isn't supposed to be a detailed testing procedure, it's basically a quick and dirty trick for verifying basic functions. Its application is likely limited, but it might come in handy.

posts.title: Traveling the Una railroad: thoughts on potential revitalization
posts.description: I've been writing a lot about railroads in Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH) lately. Despite abysmal rail passenger numbers, I've been fascinated by the unique scenery of Bosnia's railways and the fascinating history of its narrow gauge legacy (Bosnabahn).
